messages:
carmen: quick RFC follow-up  proposal to "gardenize" small, related services into a curated surface: group utilities (authn helpers, tenant-metadata, small enrichers) into a "service garden" to reduce cross-team churn and clarify ownership. aim: pay down churn debt and make public SDK surface smaller. want opinions on grouping rules and migration cadence.
leo: high level +1. main risk is forming a monolith again. we need strict module contracts and per-module SLAs inside the garden.
sasha: agree with contracts. propose a rule set: 1) API surface for each garden module must be < 10 endpoints 2) each module has explicit README + contract tests 3) teams own adapters, not internals.
nora: rollout suggestion: phased merge by dependency graph: start with leaf utilities with few callers, then mid-tier, avoid core hotpath pieces in phase1. also require dual-deploy compatibility for 2 weeks.
carmen: checklist draft: "- define garden module manifests (owner, endpoints, sla, adapters)
- implement compatibility facade for each module
- run contract tests + backfill compares for 25k calls
- enable module-by-module routing via feature-flag
- monitor p99 latency, error-rate, and churn (api-change freq)
- schedule cleanup sprint to remove legacy libs after 30d"
leo: governance: need a lightweight review board for changes to garden modules (weekly triage). otherwise we just move churn into the garden.
sasha: also add cost allocation tag per module and require a budget sign-off for infra increases. platform should not silently absorb growth.
nora: observability: ensure trace propagation across garden boundaries and emit module-id in spans. add an automated alert if trace breaks.
carmen: migration safety: require a canary cohort (5 tenants) and a parity delta threshold (token-diff <0.2% for text transforms, numerical drift <0.1% for metrics). revert if exceeded.
leo: long-term: if garden modules accrete more responsibilities, split them into their own teams or surface them as explicit services with separate SLAs. garden is an intermediate stage, not forever.
sasha: tiny pedantic point: standardize API versioning and deprecation headers so consumers can do automated migrations.
infra-bot: note: "service-garden-v1" manifest draft created at 2026-03-12T14:18Z. contract-test CI job scaffolded.
carmen: thanks  I'll update RFC with the module manifest proto and the rollout epic. react with :thumbsup: if you approve the garden plan.
leo: :thumbsup:
sasha: :thumbsup:
nora: :thumbsup:
carmen: great, I'll create the epic and tag owners. leave comments here if any other gates needed.
